Effects of Thiazolidinediones on Stroke Recovery: A Case-Matched Controlled Study Anti-inflammatory therapy decreases infarct size and enhances stroke recovery. Thiazolidinedione peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR)gamma agonists have potent anti-inflammatory and insulin-sensitizing anti-diabetic actions. Thirty stroke patients with type 2 diabetes admitted for acute inpatient stroke rehabilitation receiving pioglitazone or rosiglitazone were matched for age, sex, initial FIMTM score and interval post-stroke with 30 stroke patients with type 2 diabetes not receiving thiazolidinediones.
